changes: Profiles: separate profiles with their own Continue Watching, My List and history, an optional PIN, and a Simple mode profile

Home in the Netflix shape: a Top 10 row, Recently added and New Episodes ribbons, an update card on Home itself, a banner that rotates every 3 seconds and opens the title when you tap its picture, and a My List button on the banner
The Movies and Shows chips switch Home itself, and series counts now gather episodes from every chat you selected
Player: two subtitles at once, an Up Next rail when a video ends, frame step, and Audio and Subtitle panels in a simpler shape
Malayalam subtitles from MSone join the automatic subtitle search, matched by name and year
Sign in on a TV by scanning its QR code with your phone inside J Player
Live streams refresh by themselves and show each stream's own name, and you can watch two live streams side by side
Downloads: pause all and resume all, speed and time left on each row, and a whole season in one chosen quality
Search inside a chat, hide a bad copy for good, and turning Global Search off now truly limits the search
Backup can also save to your own Saved Messages, and the Profile page shows your viewing activity and this device's data usage
